objectives: The goal of this course is to let student have basic background in financial stochastic processes which can be used to study further quantitative finance.
content: “Brownian Motion, Stochastic Integration and Ito-Doeblin Formula, Martingale Representation Theorem, Girsanov Theory, Black-Scholes Model and Option Pricing, Arbitrage Theory, Black-Scholes PDE, Feynman-Kac Representation.“
books: “Steve E. Shreve: Stochastic Calculus for Finance II (Continuous-Time Models), Springer-Verlag,, 2004.“

distribution_conditions.rule: 學制:限學士班。指定課程:必須先修ST6021、先修ST6038。且檢定指定課程平均成績達70分以上。
